zero-powers.name: Compassion
zero-powers.summary: Fills 1 section when you restore HP or MP to one or more allies.
zero-powers.description: This trigger activates when you restore the Hit Points and/or Mind Points of one or more allies (this only triggers with effects that autonomously restore Hit Points or Mind Points, not those that increase recovery caused by a different effect).

zero-powers.name: Defiance
zero-powers.summary: Fills 1 section at the start of your turn if a Villain or champion enemy is present.
zero-powers.description: This trigger activates at the start of your turn during a conflict, provided one or more Villains and/or champion-Rank enemies are present on the scene.

zero-powers.name: Love
zero-powers.summary: Fills 1 section when the PC you love loses HP or surrenders; fills clock on Sacrifice.
zero-powers.description:
Special rule: when you choose this trigger for your Zero Power, tie it to another Player Character you have fallen in love with (the feeling doesn't have to be reciprocal, but make sure everyone in the group is comfortable with this dynamic).

This trigger activates when the character you love loses Hit Points (unless that HP loss was self-inflicted) and/or Surrenders, provided you are able to see them.

If the character you love Sacrifices themselves and you witness their Sacrifice, fill your Zero Clock; at the end of the scene, choose a different trigger for your Zero Power.

zero-powers.name: Revenge
zero-powers.summary: Fills 3 sections when you enter Crisis for the first time in a scene.
zero-powers.description: This trigger activates when you enter Crisis for the first time during a scene.

zero-powers.name: Sequence
zero-powers.summary: Fills 2 sections when an ally you can see unleashes their zero effect.
zero-powers.description: This trigger activates when an ally you can see unleashes their zero effect.

zero-powers.name: Strategy
zero-powers.summary: Fills 1 section at turn end if enemies suffer from two or more total status effects.
zero-powers.description: This trigger activates at the end of your turn during a conflict, provided one or more enemies present on the scene are suffering from a total of two or more different status effects (such as one dazed and weak enemy, or one slow enemy and another enraged enemy).

zero-powers.name: Synergy
zero-powers.summary: Fills 1 section for each creature hit that was Vulnerable to your damage type.
zero-powers.description: This trigger activates when you deal damage to one or more creatures, filling 1 section for each creature that was Vulnerable to the type of damage dealt.

zero-powers.name: Zero Blitz
zero-powers.summary: Perform a free attack with each equipped weapon with extra damage or accuracy.
zero-powers.description: You perform a free attack with each weapon you have equipped. If you only have one weapon equipped, the attack deals 20 extra damage; or, if you have more than one weapon equipped, you gain a +5 bonus to the Accuracy Check for each attack.

zero-powers.name: Zero Chance
zero-powers.summary: Predict odd/even on 3d6 to trigger scaling attacks, untyped damage, or mass recovery.
zero-powers.description:
Choose odd or even, then roll 3d6 and see how many dice match your prediction. Then, apply the corresponding effect or the effect immediately above it, your choice.
• No dice: Fill 3 sections of your Zero Clock, and fill 1 section of the Zero Clock of every other Player Character you can see. Then, perform an additional action.
• One die: You perform a free attack with one weapon you have equipped. This attack deals extra damage equal to the total rolled on the 3d6.
• Two dice: You deal damage equal to (30 + half your level + the total rolled on the 3d6) to one creature you can see. This damage has no type (ignore Affinities).
• Three dice: You and every ally you can see recover from all status effects and recover an amount of HP and MP equal to (your Crisis score + the total rolled on the 3d6). Finally, if all three dice show the same number, you may perform an additional action during this turn (this is in addition to the action granted by "no dice").

zero-powers.name: Zero Cost
zero-powers.summary: Halve all Inventory Point costs for the scene and perform a free Inventory action.
zero-powers.description: Until the end of the scene, you treat all Inventory Point costs as being halved. You may also immediately perform the Inventory action for free.

zero-powers.name: Zero Elements
zero-powers.summary: Choose two elements; your damage converts to those types, ignores Affinities, and deals +5 damage.
zero-powers.description:
Special rule: when you select this effect for your Zero Power, choose two damage types among air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, ice, light, and poison.

You gain the following benefits: all damage you deal becomes of a type of your choice among the two you selected when you created this Zero Power, its type cannot change, and it ignores Absorptions, Immunities, and Resistances. Additionally, you deal 5 extra damage (be it with attacks, spells, items, Arcana, or any other method).

These benefits last until the end of the scene, until you unleash this power again, or until you end its effects (you may do so whenever you want).

You may also perform an additional action during this turn.

zero-powers.name: Zero Limits
zero-powers.summary: Boost all Attributes by one die size for the scene and take an additional action.
zero-powers.description: Until the end of the scene, treat all your Attributes as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12). You may also perform an additional action during this turn.

zero-powers.name: Zero Magic
zero-powers.summary: Perform the Spell action for free at 0 MP cost with +10 extra damage and +5 Magic Check.
zero-powers.description: You perform the Spell action for free, casting a spell of your choice among those you know; the spell's total Mind Point cost is treated as being 0 (this includes any cost increases due to Skills and effects). The spell deals 10 extra damage and, if it is an offensive spell, you gain a +5 bonus to the Magic Check.

zero-powers.name: Zero Objective
zero-powers.summary: Fill or erase 3 sections of a Clock tied to the current scene.
zero-powers.description: Choose one option: fill 3 sections of a Clock tied to the current scene; or erase 3 sections of a Clock tied to the current scene.

zero-powers.name: Zero Remedy
zero-powers.summary: Cleanse status conditions and restore HP to yourself and all allies you can see.
zero-powers.description: You and any number of allies you can see recover from all status effects and recover an amount of Hit Points equal to (40 + half your level).

zero-powers.name: Zero Scourge
zero-powers.summary: Deal elemental damage and inflict chosen status conditions on all visible targets.
zero-powers.description:
Special rule: when you select this effect for your Zero Power, choose a damage type among air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, ice, light, and poison; then, choose two status effects among dazed, shaken, slow, and weak.

Choose any number of creatures you can see: you deal (30 + half your level) damage of the chosen type to each of them, and they suffer the chosen status effect.

zero-powers.name: Zero Shield
zero-powers.summary: Halve all incoming damage suffered by you and your allies until your next turn.
zero-powers.description: Until the start of your next turn, all damage suffered by you and every ally present on the scene is halved (before applying Affinities).

zero-powers.name: Zero Triangle
zero-powers.summary: You and up to two allies perform a free attack with a +5 Accuracy Check bonus.
zero-powers.description: You and up to two allies you can see perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped (or a basic attack if they are NPCs). These attacks receive a +5 bonus to the Accuracy Check.
